name: frequent-research-frontend
description: Frequent Research website: React app built with Vite. Talks to the Express backend in ../backend through /api.

scripts.prerender: node scripts/step.cjs 1 'search-engine pages (10-20 min)' && node scripts/prerender.cjs dist --origin https://www.frequentresearch.com && node scripts/step.cjs 2 'chat knowledge base' && node scripts/build-chat-kb.cjs dist public/data dist/data && node scripts/step.cjs 3 'llms.txt' && node scripts/make-llms.cjs dist --origin https://www.frequentresearch.com && node scripts/step.cjs 4 'first-screen copies of every page (60-90 min, the longest step)' && node scripts/phone-shell.cjs dist && node scripts/step.cjs 4b 'SEO pass (5-10 min)' && node scripts/seo-pass.cjs dist --origin https://www.frequentresearch.com && node scripts/step.cjs 4c 'AI catalogs (1 min)' && node scripts/ai-catalog.cjs dist --origin https://www.frequentresearch.com && node scripts/step.cjs 5 'admin page index (10-20 min)' && node scripts/site-index.cjs dist && node scripts/step.cjs 6 'compressed copies' && node scripts/compress.cjs dist && node scripts/step.cjs done 'website ready in dist/'
scripts.preview-file: FR_SINGLE=1 vite build --outDir dist-single && node scripts/make-preview.cjs dist-single
